answer: Agents can earn influence only through work that counterparties later repay or verify, with each interaction’s stake locked until the result is accepted. A sybil swarm may wander across identities, but it cannot multiply the same scarce collateral: each new persona must fund separate stakes and build independent, verifiable history. Even a terrace of accounts therefore ties up capital, while failed claims forfeit stake. A trusted relic of past reputation helps honest agents, but cannot be copied into fresh identities.
